subject.title: fix: inherit provider-level contextWindow/maxTokens when applying model defaults

question: Which overlapping branch should become the canonical implementation for provider-level model defaults?
rationale: This PR, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105807, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105841 modify the same defaulting block with different scope and proof quality; landing them independently risks conflicts and an inconsistent three-field contract.

options.title: Consolidate on the broader candidate
options.body: Confirm https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105807 is cleanly mergeable and use it as the canonical all-three-fields implementation.

options.title: Complete this branch
options.body: Add `contextTokens`, correct the partial-input fixture typing, provide branch-specific proof, and close the overlapping candidates after this branch is selected.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the broader candidate
recommendation.body: Confirm https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105807 is cleanly mergeable and use it as the canonical all-three-fields implementation.
